title: discovery.py: Unvalidated RREQ hop_limit causes crash
description: Line 131: `actual_hops = INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT - rreq.hop_limit` produces negative value when rreq.hop_limit > INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT (4). RREQ.from_bytes() accepts any uint8 hop_limit (0-255) without validation. A malformed RREQ with hop_limit=255 results in actual_hops=-251, and RouteEntry(hop_count=-251) raises ValueError from __post_init__. Attacker can DoS the router with a crafted RREQ.
close_reason: Fixed: Added hop_limit validation in RREQ.from_bytes() to reject values > MAX_HOP_LIMIT (15). Crafted RREQ with hop_limit=255 now raises LoadngError at parse time instead of causing negative hop_count crash in process_rreq(). Added regression test test_rreq_from_bytes_rejects_invalid_hop_limit.
